title: Hamburg City Health Study - a German Cohort Study
official: A Single Center, Prospective, Epidemiologic Cohort Study With Emphasis on Imaging to Improve the Identification of Individuals at Risk for Major Chronic Diseases and to Improve Early Diagnosis and Survival
summary: The Hamburg City Health Study (HCHS) is a large, prospective, long-term, population-based cohort study and a unique research platform and network to obtain substantial knowledge about several risk and prognostic factors in major chronic diseases.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Inhabitant of the city of Hamburg at the time of inclusion into the study (Inclusion is time of written consent)
* Age 45 to 74 years
* Personally signed informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Insufficient knowledge of the German language, in order to understand study documents and computer assisted interview without translation
* Physical or psychological incapability to travel to the study center and to cooperate in the investigations
